p1.name: Flood Impact & WSS Damage
p1.method: P1 uses affected-population impact and, where PDNA raw data are available, water-supply-system impact. Within P1, affected-population impact contributes 40% and WSS impact contributes 60%.

p2.name: Current Water Service & Safety
p2.method: P2 uses current water-system service status and drinking-water safety/public-health observations from PDNA raw data. The PDNA signal has more influence where assessed WSS beneficiaries represent more of the affected population. Where no current PDNA raw data are available, P2 is provisionally set to 2.5.

cautions: PDNA raw WSS beneficiary populations may overlap between schemes and are not treated as unique people.
The PDNA coverage adjustment compares assessed WSS beneficiary population with affected population and is capped at 100%.
Physical damage is used in P1; service functionality is used in P2 to avoid double counting.
A provisional P2 of 2.5 is used only where current PDNA raw data are unavailable.
